text: atha kho māro pāpimā .pe. tatthevantaradhāyīti . catutthaṃ paṭhamapāsasuttaṃ [425] evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye . tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi bhikkhavoti . #1 ma. paddhagū . bhadanteti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ . bhagavā etadavoca mayhaṃ kho bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā yonisosammappadhānā anuttarā vimutti anuppattā anuttarā vimutti sacchikatā tumehapi bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā yonisosammappadhānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ anupāpuṇātha anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarothāti . [426] atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi bandhosi 1 mārapāsena ye dibbā ye ca mānusā mārabandhanabandhosi na me samaṇa mokkhasīti . [427] muttāhaṃ 2 mārapāsena ye dibbā ye ca mānusā mārabandhanamuttomhi nihato tvamasi antakāti . atha kho māro pāpimā .pe. tatthevantaradhāyīti . pañcamaṃ dutiyapāsasuttaṃ [428] evamme sutaṃ
